WCAG 2.1 AA · KEYBOARD & SCREEN-READER FRIENDLY

Accessibility Statement

We built `createandcare.eu` so adults of all backgrounds and abilities can read, navigate and take part easily.

How We Designed for Accessibility

  • High-contrast Pastel Retro palette: All text pairings pass WCAG 2.1 AA contrast requirements (at least 4.5:1 for body copy, with primary `--plum` text exceeding 7.8:1 across all pastel backgrounds).
  • Full keyboard navigation: Every interactive element is reachable via `Tab`, features a clear `3px solid` brick-red focus outline, and includes a “Skip to main content” link.
  • Respects reduced motion: Visitors with `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` enabled experience no transitions or animated movement.
  • Works without JavaScript: If JavaScript is unavailable, the mobile navigation and all three “Who are you?” audience panels remain visible and usable.
  • Multilingual typography: Our self-hosted fonts include full Latin Extended support for German, Portuguese and Turkish characters.
